question: Can a small tied causal nonnegative persistent-regime HMM losslessly recode the actual decoder-reconstructed POLARIS/STRATA selected decisions enough to make the current finite reconstruction satisfy F<=0.8?

required_authentication: current finite artifact held regular-file descriptor, exact bytes and SHA-256
independent extraction receipt held descriptor and SHA-256
every raw stream array held descriptor, bytes and SHA-256
every original arithmetic payload held descriptor, bytes and SHA-256
extraction receipt binds a canonical trace-inventory SHA-256 without a lock/receipt hash cycle
exact original arithmetic logical length, payload bytes and payload SHA-256 replayed from extracted bits and frequencies

fields: small coordinate phase t mod P for P in {1,2,4}
public_decoder_context.resets: at every canonical arithmetic-stream boundary and every 4096 selected decisions

gate_A0_local_subclass.probability_fit: Jeffreys 1/2 count smoothing, then deterministic Q0.16 rounding
gate_A0_local_subclass.purpose: cheap exact finite-order screen and initialization only
gate_A0_local_subclass.claim_boundary: failure closes only the depth<=8 Markov subclass; it cannot close a latent-state HMM or a general edge-emitting WFA because long persistent regimes and global constraints may have zero short-context gain

gate_A1_true_hidden_state.family: tied nonnegative state-emitting persistent-regime HMM subclass
gate_A1_true_hidden_state.matrix_definition: A_(c,y)[i,j] = T[i,j] * E[c,j,y] with one shared nonnegative row-stochastic T, context/state emissions E, and initial pi
gate_A1_true_hidden_state.causal_update: alpha_t = alpha_(t-1) A_(c_t,y_t) normalized to sum one

fit.algorithm: scaled Baum-Welch forward/backward on canonical reset chunks
fit.selection: minimum exact quantized-model arithmetic packet bytes; ties by smaller chi, smaller P, then seed order

gate_A1_true_hidden_state.claim_boundary: a miss closes this finite chi<=64, P<=4, reset-4096 state-emitting HMM cell only; symbol-independent T followed by target-state emission is not a generic edge-emitting WFA and cannot realize the canonical fixed-horizon even-parity language without a terminal right environment or terminal-position context; this is not a converse for arbitrary tensor networks, unbounded bond dimension, or noncausal site-specific MPS

score_order: authenticate source-only manifest and independent review before numeric import
reserve an absent output directory before opening any receipt or stream
hold and authenticate the current exact artifact, extraction receipt and all source stream arrays
replay the current arithmetic codelength from canonical bits and regenerated frequencies
run A0, retaining its local-only claim boundary
run every A1 chi/period/seed cell or emit an explicit incomplete result that cannot kill A1

hard kill if every complete A1 cell has net saving below 0.1528899669629145 bpw
only after an absolute source survivor, open independently encoded Gaussian-control locks and refit every candidate independently
write result and controls, verify all held descriptors stable, then write COMPLETE.json last

whole_layer_expert_holdout.rule: for each test stream, training excludes every stream with the same layer_group OR the same expert_group
required_reports: model bytes, stream framing and arithmetic termination

gaussian_controls.construction: moment-matched Gaussian tensors are independently passed through the complete frozen POLARIS/STRATA encoder and independent extractor; source decisions are never permuted or reused
gaussian_controls.model_refit: the source-selected A1 chi and P are independently refit from all three frozen seeds, quantized, training-selected, arithmetic-coded and charged for each control; source bits or fitted tensors are never reused
gaussian_controls.reported_statistic: source direct saving minus the distribution of independently encoded Gaussian direct savings

physical_packet.layout: one page-rounded global model/directory followed by one sequential variable-length expert frame per routed expert
global_charges: quantized pi, T and E tensors
local_charges: the exact arithmetic termination bits and final byte padding already present in every measured payload
any padding required to keep R>=2.15
physical_packet.storage_rule: all model, header, directory, payload, termination, alignment and padding bytes count once
physical_packet.cold_rule: all global model pages plus the worst-unaligned page union of the selected sequential expert frame
physical_packet.rejection: reject any emitted candidate outside 2.15<=R<=2.5 or with cold read amplification >=2

information_identities_and_proposal_crit.deterministic_statistic: for b=f(q), H(q)-H(q|b)=H(b); transmitting b at its entropy cannot itself save lossless rate
information_identities_and_proposal_crit.FIBER_boundary: a deterministic fibre label can change lossy cell geometry or search, but its mere transmission supplies no entropy rebate
information_identities_and_proposal_crit.RCC_boundary: fixed-cap allocation cannot create entropy; tail probability, failure fallback, candidate-search selector, reservoir slack, framing and termination must all be charged
information_identities_and_proposal_crit.ORBIT_MERA_boundary: an orthogonal transform preserves raw SSE and helps only through a changed quantizer factorization; source-adaptive transforms require transmitted parameters
information_identities_and_proposal_crit.Riemannian_flow_boundary: volume-preserving flows preserve differential entropy; other flows must charge their Jacobian-realizing parameters and can only be credited through one finite decoded packet

Gray_Wyner_evidence.interpretation: even the audited favourable same-layer opportunity is far below the 14.57% speculative capture and about fifteen times below a 25% common-variance aspiration; shared pages also enter every cold routed read

universality.architecture: one versioned algorithm for arbitrary SwiGLU-MoE expert shapes and any canonical POLARIS-like binary decision trace
universality.decoder_inputs: shape/role semantics, selected expert bytes, charged global model bytes and causally decoded state
universality.forbidden: model provenance, public ancestors, router or token activations, model-specific pretrained networks, identity keys and untransmitted fitted state

lifecycle.wrong_token_behavior: reject before output creation, review input, stream input, NumPy, CuPy or CUDA
lifecycle.valid_token_behavior: reserve create-new output, authenticate review and source closure, then import CuPy and open held inputs
lifecycle.symlink_policy: O_NOFOLLOW regular held descriptors and exclusive O_EXCL output members
lifecycle.completion: COMPLETE.json is exclusive and last; incomplete outputs are never resumed
